parameters.formDescription: Upload a sales export from any location. Accepts .xlsx and .csv files up to 5 MB.

parameters.query:
UPDATE spreadsheet_import_runs
SET
  total_rows = {{ $('Build Import Summary').first().json.total_rows }},
  valid_count = {{ $('Build Import Summary').first().json.valid_count }},
  suspicious_count = {{ $('Build Import Summary').first().json.suspicious_count }},
  invalid_count = {{ $('Build Import Summary').first().json.invalid_count }},
  status = 'staged'
WHERE id = {{ $('Build Import Summary').first().json.import_run_id }}
RETURNING id, status;

parameters.completionMessage: Your file has been received. Review the staged rows in the Supabase dashboard.
